translate_en|mods/ViewpointRightClick/42: Fix right click in the 3D view

In first and third person with the mouse cursor shown: one right click opens the menu of what is under the cursor, animals included. While you look around with the mouse, and in the isometric view, right click works as before.
How far from your character a right click in the 3D view can open a menu. Things farther away open none (Viewpoint alone reaches across the street). The chosen action walks you there as usual.
